subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: The Business Case for Green
description: One-minute skill: The Business Case for Green.

hook.text: Unilever's sustainable brands grew 69% faster than the rest of its portfolio. Green isn't just good—it sells.

buildup.text: Sustainability reduces costs (energy, waste), attracts customers, and protects against regulatory risk.

discovery.text: Green supply chains also attract investors. ESG-focused funds now manage over $30 trillion globally.

twist.text: The upfront cost of going green is real. Payback takes 2–5 years. Short-term thinkers quit too early.

climax.text: Companies with strong sustainability programs outperform peers on stock returns over 10-year periods.

punchline.text: Green is good business. The numbers prove it.

quiz.question: How much faster did Unilever's sustainable brands grow?
